''See also: [[Watchman Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Watchman is a title used by members of the [[Blackwatch]], an elite and disciplined military order within [[The Empire{{!}}the Empire]]. Founded by a woman who chose the name to avoid appearing superior to her male peers, the order was established by the Emperor to harness and turn the power of the [[Elders]] against them. The [[Blackwatch]] serves as a protective barrier between humanity and unspeakable threats, specializing in the study, containment, and combat of [[Elders]] and their spawn. Their crest is known as the Elder's Eyes, which depicts a nest of tentacles topped by six inhuman eyes. Members of the [[Blackwatch]] are easily identified by their distinctive black uniforms, often featuring silver buttons. They utilize specialized equipment, such as ancient [[Iron{{!}}iron]] spikes designed to pin and seal [[Elderspawn]] alive. While the order is highly respected for its role in protecting civilization, they are also viewed with suspicion and fear by the public; some see them as necessary guardians, while others suspect they are cult-like acolytes performing dark rituals. The leadership of the [[Blackwatch]] has included figures such as [[Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss]] and her aide, [[Alsa Grayweather]].}}
